name: Kinomoto Misaki
source: The third daughter of the family, [url=/c9815]Sakuya's[/url] younger twin sister and [url=/c83454]Kyouichi's[/url] classmate. A kind girl who is always ready to stand up for others. Just like her twin sister she loves Kyouichi, but because she's aware of Sakuya's feelings for him, she keeps them hidden.
